title: Report Formatter
summary: Builds reusable PDF templates with editable fields, browser OCR, saved drafts, and layout-matched report exports.
coverAlt: Template builder showing draggable fields and percentage-calculation settings.
coverCaption: Template builder with calculated fields on a synthetic two-page PDF used in browser tests.
contributions: Designed the reusable-template builder, report editor, and configurable image-extraction workflow.
Specified revision-safe drafts, annotation tools, calculations, and PDF layout requirements.
Reviewed AI-assisted implementation across the interface, PDF processing, persistence, and regression tests.
